title: First Matching Character From Both Ends
description:
You are given a string s of length n.

Find the smallest index i such that:

s[i] == s[n - i - 1]
Task
Compare characters from start and end (mirror positions)
Return the smallest index i where both characters match
If no such index exists, return -1
Important Note
If i == n - i - 1 (middle character in odd length),
it always matches itself
Examples

Example 1

s = "abcacbd"
→ 1

Example 2

s = "abc"
→ 1

Example 3

s = "abcdab"
→ -1
input_format: The input contains a single string.
